title: ARIA - Describedby
product-requirement: Screen readers should read out the elements specified by the aria-describedby attribute
specification: When enabled, the screen reader SHOULD use the semantic document structure and ARIA markup
assertion: Test passes if the screen reader reads out the text content of elements specified (by their id's) in the focused div element's aria-describedby value. E.g. aria-describedby="description1 description2". It should also read out the text content of the element with the aria-describedby attribute
